{{Top|leg}}
A '''sonic discharge cell''' was a modified [[Energy cell (vibroblade)|energy cell]] that was used to augment many types of [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]]. This cell released sound waves upon impact and few types of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] were capable of protecting an individual against this type of attack. The Mark II & III versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in the potential for sonic damage.
